column3: “forty days were required” renders “forty days were fulfilled for him.”
“beyond the Jordan” here may mean west of it from the narrator's view, and the location is uncertain.
“they sent a message” renders “they commanded (sent word).”
“this present result” renders “as it is this day.”
“spoke kindly to them” renders “spoke to their heart.”
“the third generation of Ephraim's sons” renders “sons of the third (generation) of Ephraim,” which may mean great-grandsons.
“will surely take care of you” renders “visiting, will visit you (paqad)” (also in verse 25).
